title: The audit notes: acknowledgements of what the book prints (<name>.audit-notes.json)
description: Written by `mcprep audit ack`. An acknowledgement says that a finding is what the BOOK itself prints (a number printed twice, an answer missing from the key, a practice set with more exercises than the reference lists); it is never for a defect of ours. The gate reads this file. Plain JSON, camelCase, pages zero-based.

itemPatterns.description: Optional: the --item-pattern regular expressions the audit used (group 1 is the label), so that the gate reads the book the way the audit did.

code.description: The code of the finding (an exercises verify code, or reference-count, reference-missing, reference-extra, reference-title). A wildcard is refused.

ref.description: The exercise (SECTION:LABEL) or the section the finding is about.

reason.description: What the book prints and where.

evidence.description: Narrows the note to the finding on this page, or whose evidence or message holds this text.

count.description: How many findings it covers; required for a section; the note applies only while exactly that many match.
